headline: Premier League live updates: Haaland fires Man City to win, Spurs remain winless
description: Erling Haaland scores yet again as Manchester City win, as a busy Saturday of soccer unfolds across Europe.

headline: Ex-Premier League ref Mike Dean says he did his job 'properly and professionally' after podcast claims
description: Former referee Mike Dean regrets his controversial comments on a podcast this week, but insists he always did his job "properly and professionally" during his 25-year career.

headline: Jacob Ramsey scores last-gasp equaliser to salvage a point for Newcastle, Bournemouth drop points from winning position again
description: Substitute Jacob Ramsey struck late on as Newcastle came from 2-0 down to snatch a 2-2 draw against Bournemouth and preserve Matthias Jaissle's unbeaten start to his time on Tyneside.

headline: Liverpool boss Andoni Iraola says Bradley Barcola is 'in a good place' but patience will help
description: Andoni Iraola does not expect Liverpool's new £123 million signing Bradley Barcola to require a "special build-up" after he made his debut in Friday's 2-0 win at Ipswich.
